decisions.reason: Operator training is a complementary service that strengthens customer relationships and supports machine use.
The fourth rotary axis is a compatible accessory that enhances machine capability and fits the existing portfolio.
Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the firm's core machinery and lacks strong alignment, making it a likely candidate for discontinuation.
High-speed CNC milling machines are central to the firm's offering and have multiple models, so they will be retained.
Automatic tool change systems are a natural extension of the firm's equipment and improve automation, so they will likely remain.
